about: The Manitowoc-Two Rivers YMCA hosts its Family Fun Candy Cane Crawl on Saturday, December 5, 2026, from 2 to 4 PM at 205 Maritime Dr.
in Manitowoc.
Families try gymnastics and festive activities, decorate holiday cookies, warm up at a cocoa bar and take photos with Santa.
Santa also goes swimming with the kids from 3 to 4 PM. The cost is $10 per family for YMCA members and $20 per family for nonmembers.

Families stroll downtown to watch each window come to life, and the fun is free for all ages.
